g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
n sequence could leave the study live in a mode you did not ask for.\n- [List a scenario's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-r
eference/studies/list-a-scenarios-sessions.md): What visitors did, as summaries. Project members only — this route is deliberately
absent from the guest allowlist, so a share-link visitor can never read other visitors' sessions.\n- [Get a session transcript](h
ttps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/get-a-session-transcript.md): The projected transcript, paged. Tool payloads and blob
s are dropped, and the stored blob URL is never returned.\n- [Set the guest-execution caps](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
studies/set-the-guest-execution-caps.md): The spend dial for anonymous visitors. A FULL REPLACEMENT — send every field. These caps
only mean something as a set, and a partial update that raised one while leaving another stale would produce a combination nobody
chose.\n- [Rotate the share link](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/rotate-the-share-link.md): Mints a new share link
and stops the old URL from granting access. Everyone you shared it with needs the new one.\n- [Invite a member](https://docs.mcpj
am.com/api-reference/studies/invite-a-member.md): Upsert by email, so re-inviting somebody is not an error. Only meaningful while
`mode` is `invited_only`.\n- [Remove a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/remove-a-member.md): Removal NARROWS
access, so it bumps `accessVersion` and cuts off any session that member already had — it takes effect at once rather than at expi
ry.\n- [Point a scenario at a different environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/point-a-scenario-at-a-different
-environment.md): Keeps the study's LINK, its members and its session history while changing what visitors actually reach. The alt
ernative — unpublish and republish — mints a new link, which means re-sharing it with everyone.\n- [Session metrics](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/session-metrics.md): Volumes, completion and feedback rates over the study's sessions.\n- [Usage
breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's sessions
used.\n- [Current window signals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/current-window-signals.md): What the miner extrac
ted from the current window — and where you get the window id the insights read takes.\n- [List scenario findings](https://docs.mc
pjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-scenario-findings.md): Every finding raised over this study's windows, dismissed ones included
— dismissal is a state on the finding, not a deletion.\n- [Read a window's insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studie
s/read-a-windows-insights.md): Poll this after requesting a generation.\n- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on M
CPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS
and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request here takes one from there.\n- [Cancel a window's generation](htt
ps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/cancel-a-windows-generation.md): Releases a generation that is stuck `pending`. Idempot
ent against an already-finished one.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/dismiss-a-finding.md): K
eyed on the finding's stable remediation id, so the same problem stays dismissed when insights regenerate. Bodyless: the path name
s the finding.\n- [Restore a dismissed finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/restore-a-dismissed-finding.md): Und
oes a dismissal. Bodyless: the path names the finding.\n- [Create (or revive) a relay tunnel for a named project server](https://d
ocs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/create-or-revive-a-relay-tunnel-for-a-named-project-server.md): Registers a server record nam
ed `name` if missing, mints a relay tunnel grant for it, and **persists the tunnel bearer URL (including the plaintext `?k=` secre
t) onto the server record's `url`** so evals and studies can target the tunnel like any remote server. The plaintext persistence i
s a deliber…\n- [Revoke a tunnel's live grant](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/revoke-a-tunnels-live-grant.md): Revo
kes the grant at the control plane and edge: the public URL stops working immediately and any live tunnel session is disconnected.
The server record — including its now-dead `url` — is intentionally left untouched, so the next create revives the tunnel with th
e same slug.\n- [List a project's plugins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/plugins/list-a-projects-plugins.md): The live (in
stalled, non-uninstalled) Agent Plugins in the project, disabled ones included (marked `enabled: false`). Read-only: import, activ
ation, enable/disable and uninstall are app flows, not API operations.\n- [Get a plugin version](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refer
ence/plugins/get-a-plugin-version.md): One imported plugin version with its component projections: declared MCP servers (placement
, auth timing, materialized server id) and declared skills (namespaced model refs). Addressed by the version id alone — access is
membership of the version's own project, and historical versions of uninstalled…\n- [List a project's skills](https://docs.mcpjam.
com/api-reference/skills/list-a-projects-skills.md): The Cloud Skills visible to the caller in this project: the project-shared on
es plus the caller's own drafts. Each row reports `pinnability`, which is what decides whether its id is usable in an environment'
s `skillSelection`.\n- [Get a skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/skills/get-a-skill.md): One skill, including its SKILL.
md body. The body is mutable and an edit overwrites the previous one in place, so `aggregateHash` is the only handle on which cont
ent this read returned.\n- [Run one headless agent turn](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/agent/run-one-headless-agent-turn.m
d): Runs ONE assistant turn over the supplied message history and responds synchronously with the final assistant text, the operat
ions it invoked, references to any resources it created, and any actions awaiting human approval.\n- [Connect an MCP server](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/connect-an-mcp-server.md): Starts a connection request for an MCP server URL.
Discovery, browser consent, and validation happen asynchronously; poll the returned `connectionRequestId` until the status is term
inal. When the next step belongs to a person, the response carries a `handoffUrl` to open.\n- [Get a connection request](https://d
ocs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/get-a-connection-request.md): Current state of one connection request. Metered on
its own poll budget rather than the shared per-caller one, so polling on a short interval is expected and will not spend the budge
t your other calls need. A 429 here means the poll interval itself is too fast; honour Retry-After.\n- [Cancel a connection reques
t](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/cancel-a-connection-request.md): Stops a request and invalidates its h
andoff link. Cancelling an already-terminal request is a no-op.\n- [Retry validation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server
-connections/retry-validation.md): Re-arms a stalled validation immediately instead of waiting out its backoff. Does not revive a
terminal request — after `failed`, `expired`, or `cancelled`, start a new one.\n- [List personas](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refe
rence/swarms/list-personas.md): The project's personas, newest first. Archived personas are excluded.\n- [Create a persona](https:
//docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-persona.md): Creates one persona. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /
projects/{projectId}/personas/generate` — that route persists nothing.\n- [Get a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/sw
arms/get-a-persona.md): A persona that lives in a DIFFERENT project answers 404, never 403 — the route is not an existence oracle
for a project you cannot see.\n- [Delete a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/delete-a-persona.md): Refused wit
h 409 while goals still reference this persona — deleting it would strand them.\n- [Update a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
